<!-- Say what changed and why, in a few sentences. Then say how you checked it. -->

- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] A change in behaviour comes with a test, under `tests/` at the path that mirrors the module it covers.
- [ ] By default the app makes no network request to anything but its own local server, and any new way of sending something off the machine is off until the person sets it up and is listed in `PRIVACY.md`.
- [ ] No sample or placeholder data reaches the dashboard.
- [ ] Tests, fixtures and screenshots contain no real session names or paths.
- [ ] `PRIVACY.md` is updated if the app now runs a new command or reads a new file.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under Unreleased if a user would notice the change.
